jobs.title: AI Solutions Support Lead
jobs.description: This is your opportunity to join AXIS Capital – a trusted global provider of specialty lines insurance and reinsurance. We stand apart for our outstanding client service, intelligent risk taking and superior risk adjusted returns for our shareholders. We also proudly maintain an entrepreneurial, disciplined and ethical corporate culture. As a member of AXIS, you join a team that is among the best in the industry. At AXIS, we believe that we are only as strong as our people. We strive to create an inclusive and welcoming culture where employees of all backgrounds and from all walks of life feel comfortable and empowered to be themselves. This means that we bring our whole selves to work. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to any protected characteristic, including age, color, disability, ethnicity, gender identity, marital status, national origin, pregnancy, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation, veteran status, or any basis prohibited by the laws that govern its operations. **How does this role contribute to our collective success?** AI solutions are becoming increasingly important to AXIS' ability to drive efficiency, improve decision making, and enhance customer and employee experiences. As AI capabilities mature and move into production, maintaining their effectiveness, reliability, fairness, and business value becomes critical. The AI Solutions Support Lead is responsible for the ongoing support, maintenance, monitoring, and enhancement of AI solutions that have been deployed into production. Once an AI solution has been delivered and transitioned from the Data Science \& AI Delivery team, ownership of day\-to\-day operational support and continuous improvement will transfer to this role. Leading a team of AI engineers provided through our strategic delivery partners, the AI Solutions Support Lead will ensure production AI solutions remain stable, performant, compliant, and aligned to evolving business needs. This role acts as the central coordination point between AI engineering, Data Science \& AI Delivery, Data Engineering, BTS, business stakeholders, and governance teams to ensure AI solutions continue to deliver measurable value throughout their lifecycle. The role combines technical leadership, operational excellence, stakeholder management, and people leadership, requiring an individual who is equally comfortable discussing model performance, coordinating incident response activities, managing enhancement roadmaps, and engaging senior business stakeholders. **What will you do in this role?** Own Production AI Solutions * Assume operational ownership of AI solutions following successful deployment and handover from delivery teams. * Establish and maintain support processes, documentation, runbooks, monitoring dashboards, escalation paths, defect management and operational procedures. once a solution has met agreed production acceptance criteria, including runbooks(those will need to be created and handed over to support team), monitoring dashboards, support ownership, escalation paths, defect management, and release evidence * Ensure clear ownership, accountability, and service management practices are in place for all production AI solutions. * Maintain an accurate inventory of supported solutions, dependencies, business owners, and support requirements. Lead AI Support \& Incident Management * Coordinate investigation and resolution of production issues affecting AI solutions. * Manage defect remediation activities and oversee the delivery of code fixes through internal and partner engineering teams. * Act as the primary point of coordination during major incidents impacting AI services. * Ensure issues are identified, triaged, prioritised, communicated, and resolved effectively. * Support post\-incident reviews and implementation of preventative actions. Monitor Solution Performance \& Effectiveness * Own monitoring frameworks to assess solution performance, reliability, usage, accuracy, cost, and value realization. * Monitor AI outputs for signs of performance degradation, model drift, bias, fairness concerns, or changing business effectiveness. * Ensure solutions continue to meet business objectives, operational requirements, and governance standards. * Identify optimisation opportunities and drive continuous improvement activities. Drive Continuous Improvement \& Enhancements * Own and manage enhancement backlogs for production AI solutions. * Coordinate development and deployment of approved enhancements. * Ensure solutions evolve in line with changing business processes, regulatory expectations, and technology capabilities. * Support release planning and production deployments. Collaborate Across Technology \& Data Teams * Work closely with the broader Data Science \& AI Delivery team to ensure effective transition of solutions into support. * Partner with Data Engineering teams to maintain data pipelines, integrations, and platform dependen : * High availability and reliability of production AI solutions. * Timely resolution of incidents and defects. * Strong stakeholder satisfaction with AI services and support. * Evidence that AI solutions continue to deliver expected business outcomes. * Effective monitoring and management of performance, fairness, bias, drift, and operational risk. * Delivery of enhancements and continuous improvements aligned to business priorities. * Smooth transition of solutions from delivery into operational support. * Well\-managed support teams and partner resources. **About You** You are an organised, technically strong leader who enjoys operating at the intersection of technology, operations, and business value. You have experience supporting complex production systems and can confidently coordinate multidisciplinary teams to resolve issues and drive continuous improvement. You combine strong technical understanding with excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, enabling you to translate business priorities into practical operational outcomes. **Skills \& Experience** Essential * Significant experience supporting, operating, or maintaining production AI, machine learning, analytics, or data\-driven solutions. * Strong understanding of AI solution lifecycles, including deployment, monitoring, maintenance, and enhancement. * Experience leading technical teams and coordinating third\-party delivery partners. * Strong incident management and problem\-solving capabilities. * Experience managing application support, service management, or operational delivery functions. * Strong understanding of data platforms, APIs, cloud environments, and software delivery practices. * Experience working with Agile delivery methodologies and DevOps practices. * Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills. * Ability to prioritise effectively and manage multiple initiatives simultaneously. * Strong organisational and leadership capabilities. **Desirable** * Experience supporting Generative AI, machine learning, large language model (LLM), or agentic AI solutions. * Experience with Azure AI, Databricks, Microsoft Copilot Studio, Azure OpenAI, Foundry, or similar AI technologies. * Understanding of Responsible AI principles, model monitoring, bias management, and AI governance requirements. * Experience within insurance, financial services, or other highly regulated industries. * Familiarity with ITIL, Service Management, or Site Reliability Engineering practices. **Working Arrangements** This role forms part of the operational backbone of AXIS' AI capability. Given the critical nature of production support responsibilities, occasional out\-of\-hours work, including evenings and weekends, may be required to support incident resolution, production deployments, testing activities, or other business\-critical operational events. **Role Factors:** In this role, you will typically be required to: Attend your local office at least three (3\) days per week to meet and build relationships with colleagues and the wider business. Engage in company activities to grow your network and build a strong team culture. **What we offer:** For this position, we currently expect to offer a base salary in the range of $175,000 \- $200,000 USD (New York, NY), $110,000 \- $130,000 CAD (Halifax, Nova Scotia) Your salary offer will be based on an assessment of a variety of factors including your specific experience and work location. In addition, you will be offered competitive target incentive compensation, with awards based on overall corporate and individual performance. On top of this, you will be eligible for a comprehensive and competitive benefits package which includes medical plans for you and your family, health and wellness programs, retirement plans, tuition reimbursement, paid vacation, and much more. Where this role is based in the United States of America, this role is Exempt for FLSA purposes. **This posting is for an existing vacancy.**

jobs.title: Field CTO - Data & Agentic Transformation, Google Cloud
jobs.description: **Who We Are** We're the Accenture Google Business Group Mid\-Market team, a specialized group of engineers, architects, and builders delivering tailored Google Cloud solutions for mid\-market, high\-growth, and fast\-paced enterprises. We partner with dynamic organizations to connect them with the right combination of Accenture solutions and Google Cloud products to accelerate business transformation and solve real\-world problems, quickly. We're expanding our team to meet the unique, rapid execution needs of the mid\-market segment. **The Domain** Data and AI are no longer back\-office functions — they're the engine of every modern business decision. And with the arrival of agentic AI, we're entering a new era: intelligent agents that don't just analyze data but act on it — automating complex workflows, making autonomous decisions, and transforming how companies operate. Google Cloud is leading this shift with the Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform, Vertex AI, and the most powerful data stack in the industry. Our mid\-market clients need lean, agile leaders who can unlock massive amounts of untapped data and rapidly turn it into a distinct competitive advantage. **The Role** You're the person the client trusts to make it happen. As a Technical Delivery Lead, you own delivery from initial solution shaping through go\-live. You design the execution approach for data and AI engagements, lead the implementation, and ensure the final product fundamentally upgrades how the client leverages data and intelligent automation. You're supported by a dedicated offshore engineering team — you set the strategic direction, and they build alongside you. But you're the single point of accountability for what ships. This role is for an execution\-focused leader who takes full ownership of their work. You care deeply about delivery quality, data architecture outcomes, agent design, and speed\-to\-value for the business. You hold yourself to a higher standard than anyone else would. You'll work directly with client stakeholders — immersing yourself in their environment, understanding their fast\-evolving resource constraints, and delivering outcomes that matter in weeks, not quarters. You'll have the autonomy to shape how they experience the full power of Google Cloud's data and AI stack, from first conversation to go\-live. **What You'll Do** * **Own the delivery.** End\-to\-end. Scope, timeline, team structure, quality, outcome. You're the single point of accountability the client relies on. * **Design how it gets delivered.** Shape the delivery approach for complex data and AI engagements — define the delivery plan, phase the work, structure the team, and manage dependencies across data engineering, analytics, and AI workstreams. Partner with solution engineers who own the technical architecture; you own how it gets executed and shipped. * **Provide technical advisory across the engagement** — Guide our mid\-market clients and teams on our offerings, technical implementation, and the underlying Google Cloud services, with a deep understanding of each client's existing environment and architecture. * **Be the client's trusted delivery partner.** You're the face of the engagement. Lead status reviews, manage expectations, navigate trade\-offs in real time, and ensure the client always knows where things stand — especially when the work involves iterative AI development where scope evolves. * **Get solutions into clients' hands fast.** Pick up where the deal ends and make it real. Stand up the delivery, mobilize the team, and drive execution from day one — delivering proven capabilities in weeks, not quarters. * **Lead across borders.** Coordinate onshore delivery leadership with offshore engineering teams. Set priorities, define workstreams, remove blockers, and keep the entire delivery machine moving at pace. * **Drive quality and outcomes.** Establish delivery governance, define checkpoints, track progress against commitments, and ensure every engagement delivers measurable client value — from data platform readiness to AI models in production. **Technical Skills \& Domain Expertise** * Data Platforms \& Engineering: Advanced proficiency in BigQuery, Dataflow, Pub/Sub, Cloud SQL, Spanner, and Bigtable for data migration, modernization, pipeline design, data quality governance, and lakehouse architecture patterns. * Analytics \& Business Intelligence: Hands\-on experience executing Looker deployments, connected sheets integrations, real\-time operational dashboards, and semantic modeling. * Artificial Intelligence \& Machine Learning: Core understanding of Vertex AI, Gemini models, AutoML, custom model training, and building production\-grade MLOps deployment pipelines. * Agentic \& Generative AI Patterns: Working knowledge of modern agent orchestration patterns, including tool use, grounding mechanisms, Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG), Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform, Agent Development Kit (ADK), A2A protocol, and Mod al, vision, life, and long\-term disability coverage, a 401(k) plan, bonus opportunities, paid holidays, and paid time off. jobs.title: ITS Leader
jobs.description: Intelligent Transport Systems Americas Region  WAS00007U Requisition \# **Joining Arup** Arup’s purpose, shared values, and collaborative approach has set us apart for over 80 years, guiding how we shape a better world. At Arup, our decisions and actions aim to produce safe, inclusive, and resilient communities, infrastructure, and cities. Arup is an employee\-owned, global engineering and consulting firm. Our integrated, cross\-disciplinary approach brings together planners, engineers, designers, digital specialists, and advisors to meet our clients’ needs. Our West Coast Transportation team is looking for an Intelligent Transportation Systems (ITS) Associate to provide local senior leadership for West Coast ITS projects and pursuits while working as part of the Americas ITS / Intelligent Mobility team. Seattle is the preferred location, with consideration for other West Coast Arup offices (Los Angeles, San Francisco, San Diego). The role will support a growing ITS business across the Americas, with a focus on West Coast clients, projects, and pursuits. **The Opportunity** The ITS / Intelligent Mobility team supports public agencies, airports, campuses, and infrastructure owners on projects that combine transportation operations, technology, systems engineering, and implementation. Example work includes: * WSDOT TSMO On\-Call and WSDOT Drone Researc * Port Hood / Hood River White Salmon Bridge Replacemen * Stanford University traffic monitoring / LPR proof of concep * CVX Studies / Concept of Operations / Engineering Service * California High Speed Rail technology suppor * TxDOT Future Connected Corrido * NYSDOT TSM * Lower Hudson Transit Link Responsibilities * Support Regional Leader to grow Americas ITS business leading the Westcoast geography. * Lead ITS / Intelligent Mobility assignments from planning and Concept of Operations through design, systems engineering, deployment support, testing, and operations consulting. * Manage task orders and work packages, including scope, schedule, budget, staffing, risk, and deliverable quality. * Provide senior technical review for ITS plans, specifications, requirements, cost estimates, Concept of Operations documents, and systems acceptance testing materials. * Support business development, client relationships, capture planning, proposals, and interviews for ITS\-led and ITS\-supported work. * Work across roadway, transport planning, civil, electrical, digital, systems, advisory, and operations teams to integrate ITS into multidisciplinary projects. Mentor junior and mid\-level staff and help build West Coast ITS delivery capacity. * At Arup, you belong to an extraordinary collective – in which we encourage individuality to thrive. Our strength comes from how we respect, share and connect our diverse experiences, perspectives and ideas. You will have the opportunity to do socially useful work that has meaning – to Arup, to your career, to our members and to the clients and communities we serve. **Is this role right for you?** * Bachelor’s degree in civil engineering, transportation engineering, electrical engineering, communications engineering, systems engineering, planning, or a related field. Master’s degree preferred. * Minimum 12 years of relevant experience in ITS, traffic operations, transportation technology, intelligent mobility, or related infrastructure work. * Experience leading projects, task orders, or major work packages, including client coordination, scope, fee, schedule, staffing, and quality control. * Experience with public\-sector transportation clients. West Coast DOTs, transit, airport, campus, city, or smart mobility experience is preferred. * Strong written, verbal, and visual communication skills for technical and non\-technical audiences. * PE preferred. AICP, PTOE, PMP, RSP, CCNA, systems engineering credentials, or comparable qualifications are also relevant. Please note that all applicants must apply directly via the job portal. If this role is not quite what you are looking for, but you are interested in other opportunities for a future with purpose, please sign up to our Talent Community where you will be kept up to date with roles suitable for you to shape a better world. **What we offer you** At Arup, we care about each member’s success, so we can grow together. Guided by our values, we provide an attractive total reward package that recognizes the contribution of each of our members to our shared success. As well as competitive, fair and equitable pay, we offer a career in which all of our members can belong, grow and thrive – through benefits that support health and wellbeing, a wide range of learning opportunities and many possibilities to have an impact through the work they do. We are owned in trust on behalf of our members, giving us the freedom, with personal responsibility, to set our own direction and choose work that aligns with our purpose and adds to Arup’s legacy. Our members collaborate on ambitious projects to deliver remarkable outcomes for our clients and communities. Profit Share is a key part of our reward, enabling members to share in the results of our collective efforts. **Benefits at Work** \- At Arup, we have a comprehensive and valuable benefits program that works for our employees and their families while keeping costs low. These benefits provide health and welfare security for you as well as paid time off for rest and renewal. As a member of Arup, everyone shares in our success through a global profit share scheme (payments are dependent on the firm’s financial performance). Our Global Profit Share Plan (paid bi\-annually) provides an opportunity for you to share in the success of the Firm. As a valued employee of Arup, you can also choose to participate in our 401(k) plan with up to 10% company match to help you save for your future **Flexible Working** \- We believe that flexible arrangements create a more inclusive way of working that supports our diversity and the wellbeing of our people. Options for alternative schedules and the ability to work outside of the office for a portion of your workweek are available **San Diego Hiring Range** – Hiring Range \- The good faith base salary hiring range for this job if performed in San Diego is $180,000 to $200,000 per year. **This range is commensurate with experience, educational background, and skill level.** Benefits are not included in the base salary. Please note hiring ranges for candidates performing work outside of San Diego will differ. **Different People, Shared Values** Arup is an equal opportunity employer that actively promotes and nurtures a diverse and inclusive workforce. We welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds, regardless of age (within legal limits), gender identity or expression, marital status, disability, neurotype or mental health, race or ethnicity, faith or belief, sexual orientation, socioeconomic background, and whether you’re pregnant or on family leave. We are an open environment that embraces diverse experiences, perspectives, and ideas – this drives our excellence. Guided by our values and alignment with the UN Sustainable Development Goals, we create and contribute to equitable spaces and systems, while cultivating a sense of belonging for all. Our internal employee networks support our inclusive culture: from race, ethnicity and cross\-cultural working to gender equity and LGBTQ\+ and disability inclusion – we aim to create a space for you to express yourself and make a positive difference. Discover more about life at Arup at www.arup.com/careers/your\-life\-at\-arup. **Our Application Process** We will be reviewing our candidates for this position on a rolling basis. Once you have applied you will be evaluated and potentially moved on to the next round, at which point a member of the talent resourcing team will reach out to you directly. **Arup is an equal opportunity employer.** All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, spouse of a protected veteran, or disability. **Stay safe online.** Recruitment fraud is on the rise, and Arup’s name, logo, and branding have been used in fraudulent job advertisements. Arup will never ask for bank information as part of our recruitment process. \#LI\-VM1

automated systems with WMS (Warehouse Management Systems), ERP (Enterprise Resource Planning), and other enterprise\-level IT systems for cohesive operations. **Risk Mitigation \& Compliance analysis frameworks for system performance, making strategic, data\-driven adjustments to optimize efficiency and throughput. * Continually lead evaluations of emerging automation technologies and trends, identifying opportunities to incorporate innovative solutions into our warehouse operations. **Mentorship \& Development:** * Mentor and develop junior engineers and technical staff, fostering their professional growth and ensuring they are equipped with the latest industry knowledge and skills. * Lead collaborative workshops and training sessions for cross\-functional teams and warehouse staff on advanced automation and maintenance techniques. * Establish a culture of continuous learning and innovation within the engineering team. **Strategic Vendor \& Partner Management:** * Develop and maintain strategic relationships with key suppliers, vendors, and technology partners globally, negotiating optimal contracts and sourcing the best automation solutions. * Lead high\-level negotiations and led automation, machine vision, and digital twin technologies. * Experience within high\-volume distribution, e\-commerce, retail, or manufacturing operations. * Strategic thinking and leadership * Advanced analytical and problem\-solving skills * Excellent verbal and written communication * Strong interpersonal and stakeholder management skills * Project management and organizational excellence * Continuous improvement mindset * Strong attention to detail * Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment * Customer\-focused approach with a solutions\-oriented mindset * Ability to work independently and collaboratively across cross\-functional teams * Professionalism, integrity, and accountability **Work Environment:** This position is located in an active industrial manufacturing and distribution center with moderate to high noise levels, temperature variations, and material handling equipment in operation. The role may require extended periods of standing or walking on concrete floors and the use of personal protective equipment (PPE) such as safety glasses and steel\-toed boots. The fast\-paced environment involves time\-sensitive and safety sensitive operations and may include various shift schedules to support production and distribution needs. **Benefits We Offer:** * Health, Dental, Vision, Employee Assistance Program * Paid Time Off; increases with years of service * Generous Employee Discount on home furnishings * Professional Development Opportunities * Tuition Assistance * Ashley Wellness Centers (location specific) * 401(k) and Profit Sharing * Life Insurance **Our Core Values:** * **Honesty \& Integrity:** Acts with transparency, discretion, and ethical judgment. Learns from prior initiatives and embeds lessons into standard work. * **Growth \& Results Focus:** Understands how transformation initiatives drive growth, cost reduction, and profitability. Keeps work aligned to enterprise priorities. * **Culture of Leadership**: Leads through influence, reliability, and example. Builds trust across functions and supports leaders at every level. * **Customer\-Centric \& Boundaryless:** Works across silos for the greater good of the organization. Ensures outputs meet the needs of executives, initiative owners, and teams. * **Operational Excellence:** Demonstrates strong organizational discipline, attention to detail, and the ability to translate ambiguity into clear, executable tools. general availability expected on weekends as needed** Immediate start preferred **Office is a converted art gallery with a panini press and espresso machine** Optional short paid trial period for candidates who are able to do one Interview Process : 1 Intro conversation with one Client co\-founder 2 Follow\-up intro conversation with the other co\-founder 3 Technical interview \- scope depends on seniority, virtual or in\-person 4 Half\-day on\-site (morning \+ lunch) building a small project together with the team 5 Optional short paid trial period for candidates who are able to do one Pay: $120,000\.00 \- $150,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) matching * Dental insurance * Health insurance * Paid time off * Vision insurance Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Sr. Software Engineer, Infrastructure
jobs.description: **About Technology at Bridgewater** The Technology team at Bridgewater engineers systems to understand the world. These systems synthesize and industrialize our global understanding into a hive mind of macroeconomic knowledge which enables us to educate and collaborate with the world’s most influential central banks and policy makers and carefully and strategically manage the world’s most important capital. Our technologists are engineering highly available, high performing, and highly secure cloud platforms and infrastructure which support and scale our investing operations. **About the Team** The goal of the Portfolio and Trading teams is to translate our understanding of how the global economy works into strategy specific portfolios and execute those investment decisions with maximum precision, efficiency, and reliability. Working alongside the Portfolio team is a uniquely talented technology group that builds and manages the platforms that allow our portfolio strategists, investors, and operations teams to create and test new portfolio strategies and logic, construct portfolios, and manifest our desired portfolios to securities we can trade in the markets. Working alongside our Trading team are technologists who design, build, and maintain the systems that power execution, data flow, and real\-time decision\-making across global markets. They work closely with investors and traders to optimize performance, automate processes, and ensure the firm’s strategies are implemented with speed, accuracy, and resilience. **About the Role** We are hiring a "Sr. Software Engineer, Infrastructure" into this team, sitting at the intersection of software engineering, testing strategy, and platform architecture, with a strong emphasis on agentic development loops and minimizing latency and downtime in production. You will own the platforms and pipelines that turn our portfolio logic into executed trades, treating infrastructure as a first\-class software problem. You will be equally at home hardening production systems and building the testing environments that let engineers and autonomous agents ship changes quickly and safely, taking end\-to\-end ownership rather than working within a narrow, traditional IT role. Success means faster, more confident delivery for our Portfolio Implementation teams, with production latency and downtime driven toward zero. **You Will Drive the Following Responsibilities** * Own critical infrastructure and application services end\-to\-end, from design through deployment and long\-term operation. * Build and govern the production pipelines that construct, validate, and execute portfolios, engineered for reliability and low latency. * Design the environments and frameworks that let engineers and autonomous agents validate changes rapidly and safely. * Accelerate agentic development loops through automation, tooling, and self\-service platforms. * Instrument systems for observability and continuously drive down latency, failure rates, and mean time to recovery. **Required Qualifications** * 5\+ years of strong computer science fundamentals in technically rigorous environments with a high engineering bar * A track record of applying software engineering rigor to infrastructure, treating cloud\-native development and CI/CD platforms as first\-class software * Ability to own both production pipelines and testing assets that cater to a large, diverse user base ranging from portfolio operators, investment engineers, and other software engineers. * Full\-stack application ownership, from design through long\-term operation (this is not an infrastructure only role) * Experience building highly available, performant, secure systems at scale (ability to deal with complex security architecture is mandatory) * Exposure to, or enthusiasm for, agentic systems and autonomous delivery; excellent communication and a fit for our transparent, meritocratic culture **Location Requirements** The anticipated onsite requirement for this role is two days per week at our Westport, CT campus. **Compensation Band** The compensation range for this role is $350K \- $500K inclusive of base salary, discretionary bonus, and potential long\-term incentive. The expected base salary for this role is between 50\-75% of the range. **Bridgewater Employee Benefits** One of our core priorities at Bridgewater is to enable our employees to build a great life and career, and we believe our benefits are an important extension of that philosophy. As such, currently Bridgewater offers a competitive suite of benefits including: * Health insurance with 100% premium covered and access to additional concierge medical services * 401(k) plan with generous employer match * Paid time off, including fully paid parental leave and a competitive PTO package * Workplace flexibility and access to back up childcare * Financial assistance for family building support, including adoption and egg freezing * Workplace wellness, including on\-site gyms, free meals and healthy snacks, and meditation rooms * An engaged and active community that includes many company events, affinity networks, and extracurricular interest groups Bridgewater reserves the right to change its current benefits program at any time, in a manner that is consistent with applicable federal and state regulations. **About Bridgewater** Bridgewater Associates is a premier asset management firm, focused on delivering unique insight and partnership for the most sophisticated global institutional investors. Our investment process is driven by a tireless pursuit to understand how the world’s markets and economies work — using cutting edge technology to validate and execute on timeless and universal investment principles. Founded in 1975, we are a community of independent thinkers who share a commitment for excellence. By fostering a culture of openness, transparency, and inclusion, we strive to unlock the most complex questions in investment strategy, management, and corporate culture. **Our Culture** Our culture is anchored in excellence, meaning constant improvement, and it is deeply tied to our mission. Because markets are objective, competitive, and getting smarter everyday, we need to keep rapidly improving to have any chance of beating them. Truth is our most essential tool for engaging with the markets and constantly improving because once you know what's true about your problems and opportunities, you can determine how to get better. Valuing truth means being transparent about your decision\-making and mistakes, giving and receiving feedback with humility, and fighting for the best answers over hierarchy, ego, or self\-interest. Operating this way is hard – it's only possible because we build meaning in our work and relationships. This meaning comes from the audacity of the mission, and the joy of working alongside people who make you a better version of yourself. The culture, like Bridgewater itself, is always evolving. In 1997 our founder Ray Dalio wrote down his lessons, starting with a Philosophy Statement which remains our foundation. This later evolved into a set of 300\+ Principles. In 2022, when Ray transitioned the company, we re\-underwrote several of those principles and evolved others, with a specific focus on Meritocracy. Today the culture sits, alongside our people, as our most important edge. When we get it right, it’s the engine that powers everything else. **Why Choose Bridgewater?** It takes all types to make Bridgewater great. We seek a diverse group of innovative thinkers and push them to engage in rigorous and thoughtful inquiry. We develop people through an honest examination of their abilities and performance, enabling personal growth and professional development. We strive to provide you with opportunities that will challenge you and unlock your potential. One of our core priorities at Bridgewater is to enable our employees to build a great life and career, and we believe our benefits are an important extension of that philosophy. As such, currently Bridgewater offers a competitive suite of benefits. Bridgewater reserves the right to change its current benefits program at any time, in a manner that is consistent with applicable federal and state regulations. This job description is not a contract and confers no contractual rights, privileges, or benefits on any applicant or potential applicant. Bridgewater has the right to change any and all terms of this job description, including, but not limited to, job responsibilities, qualifications and benefits. Nothing in this job description constitutes an offer or guarantee of employment. **Bridgewater Associates, LP is an Equal Opportunity Employer**

jobs.title: Senior Growth Engineer - Full-Stack Product Engineer
jobs.description: Senior Growth Engineer — Client Opportunity **Our client, Firecrawl, is hiring a Senior Growth Engineer for a full\-time opportunity in the San Francisco Bay Area, California.** **Employment Type:** Full\-time **Location:** San Francisco Bay Area, CA **Hiring:** 1–2 positions **Equity:** Competitive equity; details shared during the interview process About the Opportunity One of our clients, **Firecrawl**, is looking for a **Senior Growth Engineer** to join its engineering team and take ownership of the product experiences that drive developer adoption, activation, and conversion. This is a **full\-stack engineering role focused on Product\-Led Growth (PLG)**. You won't simply be building features and handing them off—you'll own the complete cycle from identifying a growth opportunity and forming a hypothesis to building the solution, running experiments, measuring results, and iterating based on what you learn. You'll work closely with product, engineering, data, and revenue leadership and will have direct ownership of measurable growth outcomes. About Firecrawl Firecrawl makes it easy to turn the web into data that AI agents can use. With a single API call, developers can convert any URL into clean, LLM\-ready markdown or structured data—solving a difficult problem that teams building with LLMs repeatedly encounter. Firecrawl reached **8 figures in ARR in its first year** and more than doubled ARR in its second year. Its open\-source project has earned **147K\+ GitHub stars**, and developers, AI agents, and leading AI companies use Firecrawl every day. Firecrawl is a small, high\-ownership team building infrastructure for the next generation of AI applications. The company operates at the frontier of AI infrastructure, building tools that help AI companies and developers gather and work with web data. About the RoleSenior Growth Engineer As a Senior Growth Engineer, you'll build the product experiences that turn developers discovering Firecrawl into active and engaged users. You'll own key parts of the developer journey, including: **Signup → Activation → Onboarding → Engagement → Conversion** You'll be expected to understand user behavior, identify friction in the funnel, develop hypotheses, build solutions, run experiments, and use data to determine what works. This role reports to the **VP of Revenue and Success** and offers significant ownership over growth\-focused product initiatives. What You'll DoOwn Growth Surfaces End\-to\-End * Own the signup, activation, onboarding, and conversion experiences. * Identify friction and opportunities across the developer journey. * Build product experiences that improve activation and conversion. * Take ownership from initial hypothesis through production deployment and measurement. Build and Ship Full\-Stack * Build production\-quality experiences across frontend and backend. * Work from the first developer\-facing interaction through the backend systems that power it. * Develop developer\-first product experiences rather than static marketing pages. * Collaborate with engineering and product teams to deliver quickly and reliably. Run Growth Experiments * Design and implement A/B tests and product experiments. * Develop hypotheses based on product data, user behavior, and qualitative feedback. * Define appropriate success metrics before launching experiments. * Analyze experiment results and determine what to scale, change, or discontinue. * Learn from experiments that don't produce the expected results. Own the Metrics * Treat activation, conversion, and other relevant funnel metrics as core engineering outcomes. * Instrument product experiences to measure user behavior. * Monitor funnel performance and identify growth levers. * Use SQL and product analytics to investigate user behavior. * Continuously iterate based on measurable results. Work With Data * Analyze product funnels and event data. * Identify drop\-off points and opportunities for improvement. * Translate data into actionable product hypotheses. * Work closely with product and growth stakeholders to prioritize opportunities. Partner With Leadership * Help shape the growth roadmap. * Work directly with product, engineering, data, and revenue leadership. * Bring technical and product perspectives to growth decisions. * Operate independently while keeping stakeholders aligned. Build for Developers * Create experiences that help developers discover, evaluate, integrate, and adopt Firecrawl. * Work with APIs, SDKs, documentation, playgrounds, and other developer\-facing surfaces. * Understand the needs and behaviors of technical users. * Optimize the developer experience throughout the product journey. What We're Looking For We're looking for a **strong full\-stack engineer who combines technical depth with product and growth instincts**. You should be someone who enjoys writing production code while also thinking about: * Why users sign up * Why they activate * Where they drop off * What makes them ado tivation rate * Product adoption * User engagement * Trial conversion * Upgrade conversion * Retention The specific metrics will depend on the initiatives you own. Working Style Firecrawl operates with a high level of urgency and ownership. The environment is fast\-moving, and priorities can evolve quickly as the company scales. The right candidate will be comfortable with: * High ownership * Ambiguous problems * Rapid experimentation * Frequent shipping * Data\-driven decision making * Direct collaboration with leadership * Learning from unsuccessful experiments * Using AI to accelerate development * Taking projects through to measurable outcomes If you enjoy environments where you can **build, measure, learn, and iterate quickly**, this role could be a strong fit. Compensation \& Equity This is a **full\-time opportunity** with competitive compensation and equity. **Equity:** Competitive equity; specific details will be discussed during the interview process. Work Authorization \& Visa Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States. Firecrawl is open to considering candidates who may require a **visa transfer**, including eligible candidates currently working in the US under statuses such as **H\-1B or OPT**, subject to applicable legal and company requirements. Visa sponsorship or immigration support for candidates who do not currently have US work authorization is **not currently part of the standard hiring process**. Individual circumstances may be reviewed based on business needs and applicable legal requirements. Location **San Francisco Bay Area, California** Candidates should be able to work on\-site in the Bay Area. Candidates who are not currently located in the area should be willing to relocate. Application / Screening To help us evaluate your experience, please be prepared to provide: * **Current location** * **Work authorization status** * **Whether you can work on\-site in the San Francisco Bay Area** * **Whether you would be willing to relocate, if applicable** * **Years of full\-stack engineering experience** * **Experience with React, TypeScript, Next.js, and Node.js** * **Examples of PLG/growth features you personally built** * **Examples of A/B tests or growth experiments you personally ran** * **Metrics or measurable outcomes influenced by your work** * **Experience with product analytics, event tracking, and SQL** * **Experience building LLM\-powered products** * **Experience using AI coding tools such as Cursor, Copilot, or Claude Code** Interested? If you're a full\-stack engineer who enjoys **building production software, experimenting with product experiences, working with data, and directly influencing growth**, we'd like to hear from you. **Apply now to explore the Senior Growth Engineer opportunity with our client, Firecrawl.** Pay: $225,000\.00 \- $290,000\.00 per year Benefits: * Employee assistance program * Flexible schedule * Relocation assistance Application Question(s): * Describe a time you scoped and shipped something without a spec or PM. How did you decide what to build? * Walk me through a growth experiment or A/B test you designed and ran. What was the hypothesis, what happened, and what did you do when it won or lost? * How do you use AI coding tools day to day, and what is something you have built with LLMs? * This role is based in the San Francisco Bay Area. Are you currently able to work on\-site in the Bay Area? If not, would you be willing to relocate for the role? * What is your salary expectation? * How actively are you exploring new opportunities? * 1\. Tell me about a PLG feature you shipped end to end that measurably moved a metric. Name the feature, the metric, and the before and after. * Have you applied to or interviewed with Firecrawl within the past 6 months, either directly or through a recruitment/consulting firm? If yes, please share when you applied or interviewed and the outcome of the process. Work Location: Hybrid remote in San Francisco Bay Area, CA

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer – VEEComm
jobs.description: **Job Description** General Motors is undergoing a major transformation, both in how we operate and in how we will influence the future of transportation. Our Software Services team is on the forefront of this work, emboldening our culture by seeking out determined, innovative individuals who will join our team to help move us forward and achieve our mission. We’re looking for an engineer who likes getting close to the metal and solving problems that only show up when software meets a real vehicle. In this role, you’ll build safety\-critical software for the telematics control unit, working across embedded C\+\+, vehicle communications, system design, integration, validation, and anomaly resolution. You’ll move between architecture discussions, deep debugging sessions, in\-vehicle investigation, and supplier collaboration to ship software that has to work reliably in the real world, not just in a simulator. **What** **You’ll** **Work On** In this role, you will work on software that lives in one of the most interesting parts of the vehicle stack: where embedded systems, vehicle networking, diagnostics, cloud\-connected services, and cellular/telephony behavior all collide. You won’t just be implementing isolated features. You’ll be tracing problems across system boundaries, debugging issues that reproduce only in real vehicles, balancing reliability and performance in safety\-critical code, and figuring out how hardware, firmware, network behavior, cloud services, and supplier implementations interact when things get weird. If you enjoy deep C\+\+ work, tough root\-cause analysis, and the kind of engineering where you can feel the difference between a clean design and a fragile one, this role gives you a lot to dig into. **Key Responsibilities** * Lead development of technical solutions for current, new, and major upcoming programs, including requirements specification, system decomposition, design, implementation, test strategy, and issue resolution. * Lead software design for the system team and drive software anomaly investigation , root cause analysis, corrective action, and verification. * Perform complex design analysis and make sound engineering tradeoff decisions across functionality, quality, maintainability, scalability, performance, and safety. * Develop embedded C\+\+ software on a telematics unit, including safety\-critical components and connected\-vehicle capabilities. * Debug software and system behavior in vehicle , in lab , and across integration environments. * Work directly with suppliers to drive end\-to\-end ticket resolution, technical clarification, validation follow\-through, and closure of field or integration issues. * Provide, communicate, and reinforce common software engineering best practices across the development community. * Act as a subject matter expert for at least one platform area, subsystem, or application component . * Contribute to architecture and design reviews and support system\-level technical direction for the team. **Required Qualifications** * Bachelor of Science in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Mathematics, Information Technology, Information Security, Cybersecurity, or a closely related field, with 4 to 6 years of relevant experience, or equivalent demonstrated knowledge such as a bachelor’s degree in jobs.title: Electrical Engineer
jobs.description: Electrical Engineer – Underground Mining **Location: Northern Idaho, USA** **Full\-Time \| Permanent \| Mining** Join a Major Underground Mining Operation An exciting opportunity has arisen for an **Electrical Engineer** to join a long\-established underground mining operation in Northern Idaho. This is an opportunity to become a key technical resource within a producing mine, working closely with **maintenance, operations and engineering teams** to improve the reliability, availability and performance of critical electrical infrastructure. The operation offers the chance to work across a technically challenging mining environment, with exposure to **underground mining, mineral processing, power distribution, instrumentation, capital projects and equipment reliability**. For an engineer who enjoys being close to the operation and having a tangible impact on asset performance, this is an excellent opportunity to take ownership of important electrical systems while contributing to ongoing site investment and improvement. The Opportunity As Electrical Engineer, you will provide day\-to\-day technical and strategic engineering support across the mine's electrical assets. You will work closely with maintenance and operations teams to identify equipment failure causes, develop engineering solutions and implement improvements that increase **reliability, maintainability and availability**. The position will also play an important role in **capital projects**, from design and equipment specification through to construction, commissioning and handover. Key Responsibilities * Provide electrical engineering support to **maintenance and operations** across the mine. * Troubleshoot and support **power distribution, switchgear, motors, controls and instrumentation systems**. * Conduct engineering analyses, load calculations and operational duty\-cycle assessments. * Specify electrical equipment including **transformers, switchgear, motors and cabling** for current requirements and future expansion. * Maintain and update **one\-line drawings, electrical prints and technical documentation**. * Manage and maintain the site's **ETAP electrical model**. * Ensure electrical designs comply with applicable **NEC requirements, safety standards and site standards**. * Identify equipment failure root causes and work with maintenance engineering teams to implement permanent corrective solutions. * Manage external engineering design consultants and provide technical input throughout capital projects. * Support the tendering and award of engineering design work. * Provide design input to ensure projects meet operational, permitting and construction requirements. * Monitor engineering schedules to ensure alignment with construction requirements. * Provide technical oversight throughout **construction and commissioning of electrical projects and systems**. * Support equipment procurement and contractor management. * Assist with scope development, change control, document control and project administration. * Work closely with **civil, mechanical and project engineering teams** to integrate engineering, design and construction activities. * Develop and maintain electrical engineering standards, procedures and SOPs. * Drive **reliability\-focused engineering strategies** across the operation. * Ensure projects and engineering activities meet the site's safety, environmental, operational and performance objectives. What We're Looking For The ideal candidate will be an electrical engineer or experienced electrical professional who is comfortable working in an operational industrial environment. You should have: * Bachelor's degree in **Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering or a related discipline**, with approximately 2–3 years' relevant experience; **or** * Relevant **trade/journeyman qualification** with approximately 3–5 years' relevant engineering/industrial experience. * Experience with **industrial electrical systems, power distribution and electrical equipment**. * Strong troubleshooting and problem\-solving capability. * Experience working with **computerized maintenance management systems (CMMS)**. * Proficiency with **AutoCAD**. * Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Excel, Word and Outlook. * Understanding of electrical codes, standards and safe working practices. * The ability to work effectively with maintenance, operations, technicians, contractors and engineering consultants. Mining Experience Mining experience is highly desirable, particularly exposure to: * **Underground mining** * Mineral processing / concentrator operations * Surface mining infrastructure * High\-voltage and industrial power distribution * Electrical maintenance and reliability * Capital projects and plant upgrades Candidates coming from other **heavy industrial, processing, manufacturing, power generation or similarly complex environments** may also be considered where they can demonstrate strong transferable electrical engineering experience. Why Consider This Opportunity? This is more than a traditional electrical engineering position. You will be working directly with the operation and have the opportunity to influence how critical assets are **designed, maintained, upgraded and operated**. You'll gain exposure across the full engineering lifecycle — from **root\-cause analysis and reliability improvement through to capital project design, procurement, construction and commissioning**. The operation provides an excellent environment for an engineer looking to build a long\-term career in mining while working on technically demanding electrical infrastructure and contributing to the continued development of a major producing mine. **If you're an electrical engineer who enjoys solving complex problems, improving equipment reliability and working close to the operation, this is an opportunity worth exploring.** Pay: $110,000\.00 \- $130,653\.66 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * Dental insurance * Health insurance * Life insurance * Paid time off * Relocation assistance * Vision insurance Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Design Engineer
jobs.description: **BH Job ID:**5033 **SF Job Req ID:**20284 Ingersoll Rand is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations and ordinances. **Job Title:** Design Engineer **Location:** Buffalo, NY (Onsite) **About Us** Imagine a company with technology leadership of over 160 years, yet it operates with the energy of a startup. Ingersoll Rand has dedicated itself to Making Life Better for its employees, customers, shareholders, and planets. We produce innovative and mission\-critical flow creation and life science technologies – from compressors to precision handling of liquids, gasses, and powers – to increase industrial productivity, efficiency, and sustainability. Supported by over 80\+ brands, our products are used in various end\-markets including life sciences, food and beverage, clean energy, industrial manufacturing, infrastructure, and more. Across the globe, we’re driving growth with an entrepreneurial spirit and ownership mindset. Learn more at irco.com and join us to own your future. **Job Overview:** The Mechanical Engineer engages in compressor design at the Buffalo Technology Center. All Mechanical Engineers are involved with design, tendering, product development, and testing of our equipment at global facilities. Principal responsibilities include high precision gearing design, casing design, and modelling and drafting components for MSG ETO and CTO centrifugal compressors. Mechanical Engineers are expected to have a high degree of tech savvy and continuously stay up to date with the latest industry trends. Extensive analytical and engineering effort is used to assure the mechanical performance of the compressor. The focus of this position is Engineered to Order (ETO) system design. **Responsibilities:** * Complete design evaluations that include but not limited to dynamic and static simulation of rotating systems, rotor design, gearing and air end evaluation, bearing behavior and affected component life. * The Mechanical Engineer will primarily be responsible for creating and interacting with CAD/CAM models, including drafting and GD\&T. * The Mechanical Engineer will be responsible for product improvement ideations. The Mechanical Engineer will determine relevant testing plans and work collaboratively to implement them in the ETO compressor products. * Production Testing \& Field Support: Responsible for ensuring the successful mechanical test and field operation of compressors. This will involve global test stand and global field operation support as well as a high degree of root cause diagnostics skills, as well as reviewing supplier quality deviation requests and review of non\-conforming materials * Tendering Support: In this function, the Mechanical Engineer directly interacts with the Tendering and Design Engineering teams to optimize compressor design to meet customer requirements. * Customer interaction: The Mechanical Engineer will have numerous internal and external customers. Must demonstrate ability to effectively communicate to a diverse audience and varying technical levels. * Work regularly, dependably and independently * Ability to travel including internationally up to 10% **Requirements:** * BSME/ BS in Mechanical or Aerospace Engineering * Undergraduate work in mechanical design, vibration, FEA, thermal modelling, dynamics or materials **Preferences:** * Computer programming skills is a plus * Self\-motivated, responsible, clear communication skills. * Experience working in a team environment * Previous work experience with 3D \& 2D CAD/CAM tools (Siemens NX/ Teamcenter is a plus) **Travel \& Work Arrangements/Requirements:** * Fully Onsite in Buffalo, NY ability to travel, including internationally, up to 10% **Pay Range:** The pay range for this role is Min \- 70000 \- Max \- 90000\. The pay range considers a wide range of factors that include a candidate’s skills; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and geographic location. **What We Offer** At Ingersoll Rand, we embrace a culture of personal ownership — taking responsibility for our company, our communities, and our environment, as well as our individual health and well\-being. Our comprehensive benefits package is designed to empower you with the tools and support necessary to take charge of your health, ensuring that together, we can continue to make life better. Our range of benefits includes health care options like medical and prescription plans, dental and vision coverage, as well as wellness programs. Additionally, we provide life insurance, a robust 401(k) plan, paid time off, and even an employee stock grant, among other offerings. These benefits are our commitment to you, so you can be your best at work and beyond. Ingersoll Rand Inc. (NYSE:IR), driven by an entrepreneurial spirit and ownership mindset, is dedicated to helping make life better for our employees, customers and communities. Customers lean on us for our technology\-driven excellence in mission\-critical flow creation and industrial solutions across 40\+ respected brands where our products and services excel in the most complex and harsh conditions. Our employees develop customers for life through their daily commitment to expertise, productivity and efficiency. For more information, visit www.IRCO.com.

This includes sales forecasting, pipeline analytics, and process optimization, ensuring commercial strategy is grounded in data and aligned with Karius's mission of delivering exceptional customer experiences. The products Karius offers today are some of the most advanced solutions available to physicians who aim to deliver better care to many otherwise ineffectively treated patients. Our tests are the result of some incredible work done by our scientists, statisticians, engineers, and physicians, all driven by the same mission. dental, and vision insurance option for employees and dependents * Flexible Spending (FSA) and Health Savings (HSA) Accounts offered with an employer contribution to the HSA * 100% employer paid Life, AD\&D, Short\-Term, and Long\-Term Disability insurance * Flexible Time Off policy for vacation and sick leave, and 12 paid holidays * 401(k) plan and equity options * Daily catered lunches and snacks fertility healthcare and family\-forming benefits with financial support * Off\-sites and many social events and celebrations * Relocation assistance when applicable $140,000 \- $210,000 a year State The Rooms/Maintenance Engineer performs general maintenance, preventive care, and quick\-response repairs to equipment, fixtures, and hotel structures. Duties involve light electrical, plumbing, HVAC maintenance, carpentry, drywall, paint, vinyl repairs, and maintaining the relaxed, high\-quality, island\-inspired environment our guests expect in downtown Music City. ### **QUALIFICATIONS \& SKILLS** * **Communication:** Read, write, speak, and understand English fluently with strong interpersonal skills to interact warmly with guests, team members, and management. * **Experience:** 2–5 years of maintenance experience preferred in a full\-service hospitality, commercial, or institutional environment. * **Technical Skills:** Basic to intermediate skills in HVAC, plumbing, and electrical troubleshooting. * **Finishing Skills:** Experience with light carpentry, painting, vinyl/wall\-covering repair, and dry\-wall patching. * **Certifications:** CPO (Certified Pool Operator) certification strongly preferred (or willingness to obtain upon hire to service our outdoor pool deck). * **Flexibility \& Mobility:** Ability to work flexible shifts, including weekends, evenings, and holidays, as dictated by hotel occupancy and event schedules. * **Licensing:** Valid driver’s license preferred. * **Safety:** Deep commitment to workplace safety regulations and health standards, ensuring zero threat to self, staff, or guests. ### **PERFORMANCE STANDARDS \& CORE VALUES** * **Island\-Class Guest Service:** Embody the Margaritaville "no worries" hospitality culture. Deliver prompt, courteous service to guests and internal departments with a focus on resolving issues quickly to exceed guest expectations. * **Work Habits \& Professionalism:** Maintain hotel standards for uniform, grooming, punctuality, and attendance. Demonstrate team\-first attitude and take ownership of daily work assignments. * **Personal Development \& Initiative:** Proactively expand technical skills, participate in cross\-training across facilities functions, and seek answers when encountering complex equipment repairs. * **Safety, Security \& Life Safety:** Actively participate in hazard identification, report security risks immediately, and adhere strictly to all emergency procedures, OSHA guidelines, and fire/life safety standards. * **Preventive Maintenance (PM):** Rigorously execute guest room PM schedules, keep supply carts stocked and organized, and ensure long\-term preservation of property assets. ### **ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS \& RESPONSIBILITIES** * **Guest Room Maintenance:** Perform daily work orders and preventive maintenance (PM) in guest rooms and suites, including troubleshooting TV/Wi\-Fi/HVAC units, fixing plumbing fixtures, changing light bulbs, and repairing furniture or hardware. * **Public Space \& Venue Care:** Maintain and repair finishes, lighting, wall coverings, flooring, and fixtures throughout public areas, lobby, meeting spaces, and outdoor recreation areas (including the Fins Rooftop Pool \& Bar area). * **Food \& Beverage Operations Support:** Assist with routine maintenance and repairs for kitchen, bar, and laundry equipment; perform enzyme treatment and cleanings for F\&B floor drains weekly. * **Life Safety \& Systems Monitoring:** Monitor fire alarms, life safety systems, energy management systems, and building automation, responding promptly to system alerts. * **Pool \& Water Features:** Conduct routine water chemical testing, skimming, and basic equipment maintenance for pool systems in compliance with health department codes (CPO required/preferred). * **Work Order Management:** Utilize the hotel’s work\-order platform to track, update, and complete work requests in a timely, efficient manner. * **Inventory \& Tools:** Maintain clean, secure, and well\-organized shop environments, tool kits, and mobile supply carts. Report low inventory or component needs to engineering leadership promptly. * **General Facilities Support:** Assist with minor lock/key issues, signage installation, water heater changeouts, electrical cart maintenance, and general building repairs as assigned by leadership. * Attend all mandatory property and department meetings and safety trainings.

jobs.title: Menlo Fellows
jobs.description: **The Role** Menlo builds open source and production AI systems, from the brain, to developer facing tools to the runtime infrastructure and humanoid platform underneath. This fellowship is deliberately open ended: tell us your strengths and we'll match you to high impact work across software engineering, systems, applied AI, or research. You'll be hands on from day one, with a Menlo engineer or researcher directly responsible for your mentorship and your results. You own deliverables at the same level as the team you join. We expect you to contribute, not observe. This is a paid internship program that runs year round. Candidates go through a rigorous interview process and get matched with a senior researcher or engineer working on real world problems. **What You'll Do** * Own a real project end to end, from problem definition through implementation, testing, and documentation. * Ship production grade work in one or more areas: product engineering, systems, infrastructure, applied AI, or research. * Work on core Menlo projects, including developer tooling, model runtime and performance, automation, and reliability improvements. * Debug real issues across codebases and environments, and propose fixes that improve correctness, performance, and maintainability. * Write clear docs, runbooks, or internal notes that make your work easy for the team to adopt. * Collaborate closely with engineers and researchers through code reviews and technical discussions. **What We Look For** * University, high school or mid\-career individuals looking for a crash course in physical AI and robotics * The ability to read unfamiliar codebases and make safe, well scoped changes. * Practical debugging skills: you can isolate problems and validate fixes. * A grasp of software or hardware engineering basics: testing, version control, and review. * A high ownership mindset and the ability to work independently with fast feedback loops. * Above all, we hire for slope: how fast you grow matters more than where you start. **Logistics** * 3 months minimum, based in one of our offices: San Francisco, Ho Chi Minh City, or Singapore * Paid role. * Open to pre university and university students. * You'll need existing work authorization for your office location, as we don't provide visa sponsorship for this role. **Why Join Menlo** You'll do real work that ships, not busywork on the bench. Genuine ownership, direct mentorship from the people building Asimov, and a chance to prove yourself on hard problems alongside some of the most curious and driven people you'll meet. If you want your work to matter beyond a paper or a demo, this is the place. **A Note on AI** You don't need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect everyone at Menlo to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement. When that's the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don't treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on. **Equal Opportunity and Accommodations** We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you're excited about a role but don't meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Menlo Research is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Menlo provides reasonable accommodations during the application process. If you need one, please let your recruiter know.

jobs.title: Robotics AI Engineer
jobs.description: **About Menlo** Menlo Research is an Applied R\&D lab building Asimov, an open\-source humanoid robot platform, and the full software stack that powers it. Our mission is to make humanoid labor economically viable, turning software into physical labor at scale. We build across the full stack: hardware architecture, locomotion, autonomy, simulation, and infrastructure. We move fast, ship to real robots, and open\-source everything we can. If you want your work to matter beyond a paper or a demo, this is the place. **The Role** As a Robotics AI Engineer, you will work at the intersection of learning and hardware, training and deploying policies that run on Asimov in the real world. This is not a research role in the traditional sense. You will be expected to get results on physical robots, not just in simulation, and to iterate fast when things break. You will work closely with the hardware, firmware, and infrastructure teams to close the loop between training and deployment. **What You Will Do** * Design and train RL and imitation learning policies for locomotion, manipulation, or whole\-body control * Run experiments on physical hardware and close the sim\-to\-real gap through systematic debugging and domain adaptation * Build and maintain simulation environments and data pipelines that support fast policy iteration * Instrument robot deployments and analyze failure modes to feed improvements back into training * Collaborate with hardware and firmware engineers to understand physical constraints and improve policy robustness **What We Are Looking For** * Strong foundations in reinforcement learning or imitation learning, with hands\-on experience training policies that run on real systems * Comfort working directly with robots, not just simulators * Proficiency in Python and familiarity with standard RL/ML frameworks (JAX, PyTorch, IsaacGym/IsaacLab, MuJoCo, or similar) * An empirical, debugging\-first mindset, you care about what actually works on hardware * Ability to move fast and context\-switch between research problems and engineering tasks **Nice to Have** * Prior work on humanoid or legged robot platforms * Experience with sim\-to\-real transfer techniques (domain randomization, system identification, noise injection) * Contributions to open\-source robotics projects * Background in control theory, trajectory optimization, or dynamics **Why Join Menlo** The policies you train do not sit in a notebook. They run on a real humanoid, in the real world, on short feedback loops. You will see your work move physical hardware within days, not quarters. You will collaborate directly with the hardware, firmware, and infrastructure teams, with high visibility and real stakes, and everything you can open\-source, you will. If you want to build the systems that turn software into physical labor, this is where it happens. **A Note on AI** You don't need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect everyone at Menlo to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. jobs.description: Job Description The Future Talent Program features Co\-operative (Co\-op) education that lasts up to 6 months and will include one or more projects. These opportunities in our Research and Development Division can provide you with great development and a chance to see if we are the right company for your long\-term goals. Nonclinical Drug Safety (NDS) helps advance high\-quality drug candidates into development by defining the nonclinical safety and selectivity of lead compounds. NDS employees evaluate Lead Op candidates and preclinical toxicity of drug development candidates, providing a mechanistic understanding of drug\-induced toxicity and assessing implications for human safety. NDS provides collaborative research in animal model development, veterinary medical and animal care, and research facility management. NDS also responds to regulatory questions in support of drug registration. The Digital Operations and Innovation (DOI) team within NDS Operations comprises a talented group of data scientists dedicated to leveraging scientific and operational data to reduce administrative burden, improve the findability and accessibility of data, and discover and implement innovative applications of AI to modernize and advance our business. **Position Overview:** We seek a talented and motivated Computer Science Co\-op to join our team for a six\-month role. This position will contribute to our efforts to develop an agentic, augmented authoring system supporting Nonclinical Drug Safety (NDS). The goal of this effort is to drive towards a "zero\-draft" process that retrieves, combines, and formats key data from structured, semi\-structured, and unstructured sources into a consistent template for our scientists. The ideal candidate will actively participate in regular sprints to design and refine agents, propose creative solutions to agent\-based workflows, and work closely with scientific and operational SMEs. In this role, you will be a valued contributor to a visible and necessary effort aimed at modernizing how nonclinical safety fulfills its critical role in the development of safe medicines for our patients. Your work will help produce stable, reliable, and consistent AI\-driven pipelines that accelerate our reporting timelines and build technology at the cutting edge of our field. The ideal candidate will have experience with the principles of Natural Language Processing (NLP) in addition to agent\-based concepts including orchestration frameworks (such as LangChain, CrewAI, LlamaIndex, or equivalent), tool calling, and API integration. Strong Python coding and documentation skills are essential. Familiarity with AWS and Google services, GitHub, LLMs, and vector databases is an additional advantage. Familiarity with nonclinical drug safety, report authoring, and summarization is a strong advantage. **Key Responsibilities:** * Design and implement agentic workflows and orchestration pipelines to automate the retrieval, synthesis, and formatting of nonclinical safety data. * Develop robust data extraction pipelines in Python to parse and clean structured, semi\-structured, and unstructured data from diverse scientific sources. * Evaluate and benchmark LLM outputs for accuracy, formatting consistency, and alignment with strict nonclinical reporting templates. * Collaborate closely with fellow data scientists and scientific SMEs to translate manual document\-authoring steps into automated, step\-by\-step agent tools and skills. * Participate in agile sprints, contribute to team code reviews, and maintain clean, production\-grade documentation via GitHub. **Required Qualifications:** * Education: Currently pursuing a PhD in Computer Science, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, Software Engineering, or a highly quantitative, research\-focused field. * Programming: Strong proficiency in Python programming with a focus on clean, modular, and well\-documented code. * Data structures: Solid understanding of data structures and proficiency in manipulating structured, semi\-structured, and unstructured data. * AI \& Orchestration: Hands\-on experience working with LLM APIs, prompt engineering, agentic tool use, and orchestration frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex, CrewAI, etc.). * Problem Solving: Strong analytical and research skills, particularly when dealing with noisy, unstructured, or ambiguous data sources. * Collaboration: Exceptional communication skills with the ability to bridge the gap between technical AI development and scientific domains. **Preferred Qualifications:** * Experience with vector databases and document embedding techniques. * Experience with text processing, OCR, and principles of NLP and NLP evaluation (ROUGE, BLEU, etc.). * Experience with cloud services (AWS/GCP) and version control using Git/GitHub. * Exposure to building lightweight developer UIs and dashboards for analytics and prototype/demo usage. **What You'll Gain:** * Cutting\-Edge Experience: Deep, hands\-on experience building  edge: Practical knowledge of how to navigate enterprise data engineering and AI development within a secure, highly regulated healthcare environment. * Real\-World Impact: A clear understanding of how modern generative AI accelerates drug safety reporting, directly shortening timelines to bring life\-saving medicines to patients. **What We Offer:** * Hands\-on experience with cutting\-edge AI and cloud technologies * Mentorship from experienced data scientists and software engineers * Collaborative and inclusive team environment * Potential for future full\-time opportunities with our Company Please note that this position may be closed before the posted end date or may remain open longer, at the You will develop, implement, and oversee project quality programs while ensuring construction activities are completed in accordance with project requirements, customer specifications, industry standards, and company expectations. This role serves as the primary quality leader on assigned projects, working closely with project management, field operations, engineering, commissioning teams, subcontractors, vendors, and customers. Success requires strong technical knowledge, attention to detail, leadership capabilities, and the ability to proactively identify and resolve quality issues before they impact project performance.
