project specifications, contract requirements, quality standards, codes, and customer expectations. * Manage inspection and test plans (ITPs), quality documentation, nonconformance reports (NCRs), corrective actions, and quality records. * Coordinate inspections, audits, testing activities, turnover documentation, and quality reporting processes. * Lead root cause investigations and corrective action efforts related to quality issues and non\-conformances. * Promote continuous improvement initiatives that strengthen project quality performance and organizational best practices. **What You'll Do** ------------------ * Lead quality management activities supporting hyperscale data centers and mission\-critical infrastructure projects. * Collaborate with project managers, superintendents, engineers, commissioning teams, and subcontractors to ensure quality requirements are clearly defined and achieved. * Review project specifications, drawings, quality plans, testing requirements, and customer expectations. * Manage inspection programs associated with civil, structural, architectural, mechanical, electrical, telecommunications, and commissioning scopes. * Monitor field quality performance and verify compliance through inspections, audits, observations, and documentation reviews. * Support testing and commissioning readiness activities, turnover requirements, and customer acceptance processes. * Maintain project quality reports, inspection logs, punch lists, NCR tracking, corrective action plans, and turnover documentation. * Provide quality training, mentoring, and guidance to project teams and subcontractors. **Why Michels Infrastructure Solutions, Inc.?** ----------------------------------------------- * We deliver some of North America's largest and most complex hyperscale data center and mission\-critical infrastructure projects. * We provide exposure to every phase of project delivery, from planning and procurement through commissioning and turnover. * We are family owned and operated. * We invest an average of **$5,000 per employee per year** in training and career development. * We perform challenging, meaningful work that supports cloud computing, artificial intelligence, digital connectivity, and economic growth. * We believe everyone is responsible for promoting safety, regardless of job title. * We are part of the Michels Family of Companies, one of North America's largest and most diversified energy and infrastructure contractors. * We offer opportunities for long\-term career growth across operations, quality, commissioning, and project leadership. **Comprehensive Benefits Package** ---------------------------------- * Health Insurance * Dental Insurance * Life Insurance * Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA) * Health Savings Account (HSA) * Short\-Term Disability Insurance * Long\-Term Disability Insurance * 401(k) Retirement Plan * Legal Plan * Identity Theft Protection and Monitoring Plan *Benefits may vary based on position and location.* **Why You?** ------------ * You like to surround yourself with dedicated, value\-driven people. * You relish new challenges and evolving technology. * You cringe when you hear: "Because that's the way we've always done it." * You believe quality is built into the work, not inspected into it. * You enjoy solving complex technical and operational challenges. * You are motivated by ownership, accountability, and continuous improvement. **What It Takes** ----------------- * Bachelor's degree in Construction Management, Engineering, Quality Management, or a related discipline and 7\+ years of quality assurance, quality control, construction management, engineering, commissioning, or related experience, or an equivalent combination of education and experience. * Experience managing QA/QC programs on mission\-critical, data center, industrial, EPC, utility, power generation, pharmaceutical, manufacturing, or large\-scale infrastructure projects. * Strong knowledge of quality management systems, inspection programs, testing procedures, turnover processes, and construction quality standards. * Experience developing and implementing quality plans, inspection and test plans (ITPs), audit programs, and corrective action processes. * Ability to interpret construction drawings, specifications, codes, standards, contracts, and commissioning requirements. * Experience managing quality activities across civil, structural, architectural, mechanical, electrical, telecommunications, or commissioning scopes. * Experience supporting testing, commissioning, startup, and owner turnover requirements. * Familiarity with ISO\-based quality systems, root cause analysis methodologies, and continuous improvement processes is preferred. * Experience with Procore, Autodesk Construction Cloud, Bluebeam, BIM 360, SharePoint, or similar construction management and quality platforms is preferred. * Strong leadership, organizational, communication, analytical, and problem\-solving skills. * Ability to effectively collaborate with customers, project teams, subcontractors, vendors, commissioning professionals, and engineering partners. * Valid driver's license with an acceptable driving record. * Ability to travel up to 75% and support onsite project assignments as required. **Join a company that powers progress. Be a part of Michels Infrastructure Solutions, Inc.—where you don't just build projects, you build a career.** *\#LI\-AS1* AA/EOE/M/W/Vet/Disability https://www.michels.us/website\-user\-privacy\-policy/

jobs.title: Senior Support Engineer, Product Data Quality & Resolution
jobs.description: **Senior Support Engineer, Product Data Quality \& Resolution** **Role Purpose** The Senior Support Engineer is responsible for investigating and resolving complex product\-data issues that prevent hardware from being successfully onboarded into Oracle data centers. Acting as a technical point of contact for operational support, the role partners with Oracle's global manufacturing partners, Product Engineering, Data Centre Operations, and cross\-functional engineering teams to investigate technical issues, identify root causes, and drive timely resolution of critical operational incidents. The successful candidate will manage technical investigations, recommend corrective actions, and identify opportunities for systemic improvement. Responsibility for implementing product or process changes will transition to the appropriate Product Engineering or Program Management teams once investigation and recommendations are complete. This role supports a global operational environment and participates in a follow\-the\-sun support model, including scheduled weekend and after\-hours coverage as required. **Technical Support \& Investigation** * Investigate and resolve complex product\-data issues impacting hardware onboarding into Oracle data centers. * Monitor, prioritize, and respond to technical support tickets within the operational support queue. * Perform technical triage to identify root causes and determine appropriate resolution paths. * Collaborate with Oracle's global manufacturing partners to investigate and resolve product\-data quality issues while ensuring corrective actions are measurable, verified, and minimize future recurrence. * Monitor daily manufacturing data feeds to identify data\-quality issues and operational exceptions requiring investigation. * Perform detailed root cause analysis, including writing SQL queries to examine raw database records and investigate non\-standard technical issues. * Read and interpret XML and JSON data to identify missing, incorrect, duplicated, or improperly formatted product information. * Utilize REST services to retrieve, validate, and submit product data where required. Use Python, where appropriate, to analyze, transform, or validate data supporting technical investigations. * **Cross\-Functional Collaboration** * Partner with Product Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Data Centre Operations, and other cross\-functional teams to coordinate technical investigations. * Recommend corrective actions that address underlying system or process issues rather than individual incidents alone. * Initiate and coordinate recommendations for systemic improvements while transitioning implementation ownership to the appropriate Product Engineering or Program Management teams. * Where investigations require work at remote manufacturing or data centre locations, coordinate appropriate handoff to the responsible Product Engineer or operational team. Track investigations, recommendations, and follow\-up activities through completion to ensure timely resolution. * **Operational Excellence** * Prioritize technical issues based on business impact, operational urgency, and data center onboarding risk. * Effectively manage competing priorities within a fast\-paced operational support environment. * Produce clear investigation reports, root cause analyses, and technical documentation. * Develop and contribute to operational knowledge articles, troubleshooting documentation, and support best practices. * Identify opportunities to improve operational processes, workflows, and data quality based on investigation outcomes. Communicate effectively with stakeholders at all levels, from engineering teams to senior leadership. * **Required Skills and Experience** **Technical Skills** * Strong analytical, investigative, and root cause analysis skills. * Experience writing SQL queries for technical investigation and data analysis. * Strong Microsoft Excel skills for data analysis and reporting. * Ability to read and interpret XML and JSON. * Experience working with REST APIs and related data sources. * Basic Python programming skills for data analysis and automation. * Understanding of data validation and product\-data quality principles. * Familiarity with server and rack\-level hardware, configuration, and topology. Understanding of Product Bills of Materials (BOMs) and parent\-child component relationships. * **Professional Skills** * Ability to coordinate technical investigations across multiple teams and geographic regions. * Excellent written and verbal communication skills. * Confidence communicating with both technical teams and senior leadership. * Strong organizational and prioritization skills. * Ability to perform effectively under pressure while managing multiple concurrent investigations. * Experience identifying and recommending systemic improvements that reduce recurring operational issues. Ability to collaborate effectively with globally distributed cross\-functional teams. * **Measures of Success** Success in this role will be demonstrated through: * Reduction in product\-data issues impacting hardware onboarding into Oracle data centers. * Faster investigation and resolution of critical operational incidents. * Reduced recurrence of issues through effective root cause analysis and recommended corrective actions. * Improved product\-data quality across Oracle's manufacturing partner network. * Earlier identification and resolution of data\-quality issues before products reach Oracle data centers. * Effective collaboration and communication across Manufacturing, Product Engineering, Data Centre Operations, and other global teams. * High\-quality technical documentation and knowledge sharing that improves operational efficiency. Consistent delivery of technical support within a global 24x7 operational environment. * **Location** : Nashville, TN

jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer
jobs.description: **Senior Data Engineer, Revenue Operations** -------------------------------------------- **About Stream** ---------------- Stream powers real\-time Chat, Video, Activity Feeds, and AI Moderation for billions of end\-users across thousands of apps, from Strava and Bumble to eBay and Patreon. Our platform processes billions of API requests per month and supports applications with millions of concurrent users, while delivering highly reliable, low\-latency services and a great developer experience. **The role** ------------ The data platform in this role is what our go\-to\-market and product decisions run on. You'll own the pipelines, integrations, and central repository that bring Stream's data together, plus the models that turn it into something the business can trust. We're mid\-migration to GCP, so there's real architecture to shape. Two things make this different from most data jobs. A Revenue Operations team owns the stakeholder relationships and the business questions, so your time goes into building durable systems instead of chasing requirements. And analytics translation is increasingly handled by AI, which is exactly why the engineering underneath it has to be right. Data modeling is the core of this role. It's a small team and a fast, unfinished environment. High drive, sometimes hectic. If you like owning a platform end to end, that's the appeal. **This is a full\-time job opening based in Boulder (3 days hybrid).** **What you'll do** ------------------ * **Build and evolve the ingestion platform.** Python/dltHub pipelines loading into BigQuery, integrating Salesforce, Stripe, Postgres, PostHog, cloud billing, and other GTM systems. Design incremental loading, write dispositions, and scheduling, and make onboarding a new source predictable and low\-risk. * **Build the transformation layer.** SQLMesh models across our layered architecture, clean and well\-tested dimensional models, and clear conventions for grain, naming, and audit. Keep the core business models accurate: revenue waterfall, GTM funnel, marketing attribution, and product usage. * **Improve reliability.** Expand data quality and observability, build freshness checks, reconciliation tests, and execution monitoring. Take point when data is stale, wrong, or late, and trace issues across pipelines, transformations, and upstream systems. * **Own the platform infrastructure.** BigQuery and supporting GCP, plus Terraform, IAM, service accounts, scheduled jobs, and deployment workflows, tuned for security, reliability, and cost. * **Enable the business.** Deliver trusted datasets to Looker Studio, Google Sheets, and our internal CRM, and run reverse ETL back into operational systems like Salesforce. * **Raise the technical bar.** Help shape engineering standards and architecture, review pipeline and model changes, and share context with the analysts and engineers who contribute to the platform. **About you** ------------- You like owning a platform end to end and staying hands\-on while you do it. You're comfortable in a small team, and you're energized by building rather than by growing an org around you. You influence through the work: architecture, code review, and clear conventions, not a title. **You have:** * 5\+ years building and operating production data platforms * Expert SQL and strong Python * Experience designing incremental, idempotent, well\-tested pipelines * Solid experience with BigQuery or another modern cloud data warehouse * Experience with modern ELT tooling such as SQLMesh, dbt, dltHub, Fivetran, or Airbyte * Experience with orchestration and CI/CD (GitHub Actions, Airflow, or equivalent) * Infrastructure\-as\-code experience with Terraform or a close equivalent * Strong data modeling skills: dimensional modeling, warehouse design, testing, and observability **Bonus points:** * Revenue Operations or GTM data experience * Salesforce and Stripe data modeling * Product analytics platforms such as PostHog * Marketing attribution and funnel analytics * MRR, expansion, contraction, churn, and revenue reconciliation logic * Working closely with business stakeholders while keeping engineering discipline * GCP depth, including IAM, service accounts, and BigQuery cost optimization ### **Why this one is worth a look** * You own the data platform the whole company runs on, not one pipeline or one domain. * Your work powers forecasting, commissions, pricing, churn analysis, product insight, and board reporting. The quality of your engineering shows up directly in how the company runs. * The stack is modern and AI\-forward: Python, dlt, SQLMesh, BigQuery, Terraform, GitHub Actions, with Claude, Cursor, and Linear across the team. * You inherit a foundation that already works, built from scratch, so you evolve and harden it rather than start from zero. ### **You'll thrive here if** * You want a broad, ambiguous platform to own and the autonomy to make calls on it * You ship fast and learn fast, even when things are unfinished * You're comfortable working with teammates across time zones **You probably won't if** you want tightly scoped tickets, a fully defined process before acting, or a slow and highly predictable environment. **Why join Stream?** -------------------- We're a Series B company with global presence and a team of around 145 people from more than 35 countries. We're backed by Felicis Ventures, GGV Capital, 01 Advisors, Techstars, and Arthur Ventures, with angels including Dick Costolo (ex\-CEO of Twitter), Olivier Pomel (CEO of Datadog), Tom Preston\-Werner (co\-founder of GitHub), and Nicolas Dessaigne (co\-founder of Algolia). We'll be straight with you: a startup is more demanding than a large company. There's no fixed playbook, you'll own things end to end, and you'll sometimes pick up work outside your title. That's also what makes it a fast place to grow. If you want real ownership and high scale more than structure and a set career ladder, you'll feel at home here. **What we offer** ----------------- * 19\+ days of paid time off plus 10 paid holidays * Hybrid work flexibility (3 days a week from the office) * Free health insurance for the employee and partial coverage for dependents (80% contribution coverage for health and 100% for dental and vision) * 401k contribution plan with 4% match * Fitness stipend * Company equity * Dog\-friendly office! * A Macbook Pro provided * A Learning and Development budget * Team lunches and plenty of snacks * RTD pass \+ free parking pass on Pearl Street * An office on Pearl Street in downtown Boulder * 12 weeks paid parental leave for primary parents * The opportunity to attend or present to global conferences and meetups * The possibility to visit our office in Amsterdam *Note: this list of benefits applies to Colorado\-based employees and is adjusted per your location of residence.* Salary (for Colorado only): Our salary ranges are based on national averages. We have wide ranges so we can be flexible and determine compensation based on a number of factors including the candidate's *skills, level of experience, and location.* *For Colorado\-based candidates we offer a salary $150,000 to $180,000 per year, plus stock options. Final offer within this range depends on experience and interview outcome.* ***Hybrid office policy:*** *applicants based (or relocating to) one of our office locations are expected to work according to the applicable local office attendance policy.* ***Equal opportunity employer statement:*** *Stream provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.* *This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation and training.* ***Note for external recruiters:*** *We currently have this role covered and do not accept unsolicited agency resumes. We are not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.*

jobs.title: Member of Technical Staff - Chemistry
jobs.description: **Position Summary** Our organization combines synthetic chemistry expertise with robotics and automation: Our long term vision is to build an autonomous synthetic chemistry lab that delivers small\-molecule discovery chemistry services to pharmaceutical and biotechnology clients. We are seeking a Scientist to join our Medicinal Chemistry group and contribute directly to client drug discovery programs. The successful candidate will design and execute multi\-step organic syntheses, propose and evaluate synthetic routes, and generate high\-quality compounds and data in support of hit\-to\-lead and lead optimization campaigns. Beyond bench chemistry, this role plays a key part in our automation mission: the compounds, reactions, and characterization data generated will help build structured, high\-quality training datasets for machine learning models, and the chemist will work directly with AI scientists and roboticists to translate synthetic know\-how into automated and self\-optimizing chemistry platforms. This is a hands\-on role requiring strong technical execution, sound chemical judgment, and comfort operating at the interface of traditional bench chemistry and emerging lab automation. **Key Responsibilities** * Design, plan, and execute multi\-step organic synthesis of target compounds in support of client medicinal chemistry and hit\-to\-lead/lead optimization programs. * Propose and evaluate synthetic routes, including retrosynthetic analysis, selection of viable pathways, and identification of scalable, cost\-effective alternatives. * Perform reaction optimization (yield, selectivity, purity, scalability) and troubleshoot synthetic problems using sound mechanistic reasoning. * Purify and characterize intermediates and final compounds using standard techniques (column chromatography, prep\-HPLC, recrystallization) and analytical methods (LCMS, NMR, HPLC, HRMS). * Accurately and promptly record experimental procedures, observations, and results in electronic laboratory notebooks (ELN) in accordance with company and client documentation standards. * Support scale\-up of key intermediates and final compounds as required by project needs. * Communicate progress, data, and route strategy clearly and regularly to project leaders and, where applicable, directly to client scientists. * Generate clean, well\-structured experimental data (reaction inputs/outputs, conditions, yields, analytical results) suitable for use as high\-quality training data for machine learning and reaction\-prediction models. * Partner closely with AI scientists and roboticists to translate synthetic routes and bench protocols into procedures executable on automated/robotic synthesis platforms, providing chemistry expertise during platform design, testing, and validation. * Provide hands\-on feedback on automated workflows (liquid handling, automated reaction setup, in\-line analytics) and help troubleshoot discrepancies between manual and automated execution of chemistry. * Support iterative improvement of self\-driving lab and automated chemistry capabilities by flagging edge cases, failure modes, and data quality issues encountered at the bench. * Maintain compliance with laboratory safety protocols, chemical hygiene procedures, and proper handling/disposal of hazardous materials. * Manage time and priorities effectively across multiple concurrent projects and client deadlines. * Contribute to continuous improvement of synthetic methods, workflows, and best practices within the chemistry group. **Required Qualifications** * B.S. or M.S. in Chemistry, Organic Chemistry, Medicinal Chemistry, or a related discipline. * 0–3 years of relevant synthetic organic chemistry experience (industry, CRO, or advanced academic/graduate research); internship or co\-op experience considered for entry\-level candidates. * Demonstrated hands\-on experience with multi\-step organic synthesis and standard purification techniques. * Working knowledge of retrosynthetic analysis and route design principles. * Proficiency interpreting spectroscopic and analytical data (NMR, LCMS, HPLC) to confirm structure and purity. * Solid understanding of laboratory safety practices and safe handling of reactive/hazardous chemicals. * Strong record\-keeping and documentation habits; experience with ELN systems is a plus. * Excellent organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple projects and shifting priorities in a deadline\-driven environment. * Effective written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present data clearly to project teams. **Preferred Qualifications** * Prior CRO, pharmaceutical, or biotech industry experience supporting drug discovery programs. * Experience with parallel synthesis, medicinal chemistry SAR exploration, or DMPK\-informed compound design. * Familiarity with chemistry software tools (e.g., ChemDraw, electronic notebooks, reaction database/search tools). * Experience with air\- and moisture\-sensitive chemistry, flow chemistry, or automated/robotic synthesis platforms. * Interest or prior experience in AI/ML\-driven chemistry, cheminformatics, or self\-driving laboratory concepts, and enthusiasm for collaborating with AI scientists and roboticists on lab automation. * Comfort working with structured data entry and an appreciation for how data quality and consistency affect downstream machine learning model performance. * Track record of authorship or contribution to publications, patents, or internal technical reports. **Work Environment / Physical Requirements** * Primarily laboratory\-based role requiring extended periods standing at the bench and working with standard synthetic chemistry equipment. * Regular exposure to laboratory chemicals, solvents, and reagents; strict adherence to PPE and safety protocols is required. * Ability to lift and move laboratory supplies and equipment (up to approximately 25 lbs) as needed. **About Our Organization** We are a contract research organization built at the intersection of medicinal chemistry, robotics, and artificial intelligence. In addition to delivering high\-quality synthesis, route scouting, and scale\-up support to pharmaceutical and biotechnology clients, our chemistry team generates the experimental data that trains our machine learning models and works hand\-in\-hand with our AI scientists and robotics engineers to build automated and self\-optimizing chemistry platforms. Scientists Scientists here gain broad exposure to varied chemotypes and therapeutic areas alongside a front\-row seat to the automation of drug discovery chemistry.
